image_space: original RGB pixels; no crop, undistortion, or geometric calibration applied
overlap_policy: Across all classes, use the highest detector_score*sam_quality. Competing classes within the conflict margin become ignore. No automatic foreground override.
development_note: Assign candidate classes from the mean wordpiece-token score for each prompt, preserving alternatives. Avoid discarding detections solely because a decoded phrase mixes class names.
